profile.name: Thiago Panchiniak
profile.role: Geographer | GIS and WebGIS Development | Data Engineering | Data Science | AI Applications
profile.tagline: Connecting territory, data, and software development to turn complex information into useful tools.
profile.bio: I am a geographer, Master in Territorial Management, and Systems Development technician, with a background connecting territorial analysis, geotechnologies, and software development. I have worked in environmental consulting, urban planning and management, and in recent years with data science and development at a market intelligence company. I work with Python, SQL, data processing, GIS and WebGIS applications, automations, and artificial intelligence integration in applications. I am broadly interested in software development, data engineering and science, and AI integration, creating solutions that automate processes and transform complex information into useful tools for different business areas.

forest.title: Who I Am
forest.summary: A path that starts in Geography and expands into software, data, and AI.
forest.description: My path began in Geography, driven by an interest in understanding territory and using spatial information to support decisions. During my undergraduate and master's studies at UFSC, I gained experience in environmental consulting, urban planning and management, and spatial analysis. Over time, I expanded into programming, systems development, WebGIS, APIs, processing routines, and tools for making data available to users.
details: Experience with ArcGIS, QGIS, GIS, geoprocessing, and remote sensing.
Work with data science, Python, SQL, and geographic information in market intelligence between 2021 and 2026.
Development of MapGenPlus, a WebGIS platform for creating videos with maps.
Current focus on software, data engineering, data science, and AI applications.
